open_points.subject: OWNER_FORM_FIELDS consumer boundary
open_points.question: Which module must consume `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`, and must the owner page and owner-request reader receive it directly or through a shared caller-provided representation?
options: The owner page and request reader each consume the data-provider constant.
One shared adapter consumes the constant and supplies the resulting field definitions to both the page and the reader.
Generation materializes both page and reader definitions from the constant.
open_points.default_guess: Use one shared adapter that consumes `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` and supplies both sides.
consequences: Direct consumption gives both modules an explicit dependency on the data provider.
A shared adapter centralizes interpretation but adds a caller-to-consumer contract.
Generation removes a runtime dependency but requires generated artifacts to remain synchronized with the release constant.
open_points.requirement: The table holds the names so that the page and the reader cannot name a field differently (Route B runs of 2026-11-25).
